## Highlights

- Cargo workspaces now use the project's own packaging manifest (`nfpm`) or the matching Cargo package to select application binaries. Companion tools and galleries are no longer packaged by accident.
- Package metadata comes from the project: description, URL and license are read from Cargo/nfpm/desktop data, and README/LICENSE/NOTICE files are included.
- Arch packages use zstd level 19, bringing compressed sizes close to native packaging.

## Changes

- Prefer nfpm manifest binaries, then Cargo package metadata, then a project-name prefix, then the existing fallback.
- Stage documentation and license files automatically.
- Never fall back to the builder's GPL license for a project package.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hyalcin70/git2pkg/compare/v0.2.0-alpha.32...v0.2.0-alpha.33
